trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Reviewed deployment history**: v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back all production regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0 — confirmed healthy, error rate 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the failing v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged. (The first incident-creation call timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to guarantee no duplicate incident.)

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
